registration_source_hashes: See immutable source_sha256 and frozen_production_sha256 in registration; validation checks every hash.
qualified_command_anchor: PLC command associated with most recent qualified and resolved tracking obligation, or first directly observed valid steady PLC command/measurement pair within frozen profile tolerance; never the immediately preceding PLC command.
anchor_initialization: No fabricated pre-takeover command. At initial takeover with no directly observed steady baseline, retain R5.2.1R startup handoff and leave anchor absent.
anchor_update_guards: tracking epoch resolved to STEADY_TRACKING within frozen tracking tolerance
cumulative_demand_trigger: First timestamp when signed net magnitude reaches frozen material_command_delta and frozen response model predicts observable released motion; never backdate to earlier subthreshold commands.
epoch_interaction: While unresolved, anchor remains fixed; same-direction command updates retain epoch age and fault evidence, update latest command and response envelope without granting fresh grace.
watch_interaction: Oldest unresolved watch and valid deficit evidence carry across updates and no-motion reversal. Qualified measured motion resolves watch under frozen R5.2.1R semantics.
return_cancellation: Before a qualifying epoch, return to anchor creates no obligation or false path-length accumulation. After epoch begins, return cannot erase accrued non-response evidence.
reversal: Existing directional epoch is deterministically replaced on material reversal; unresolved watch persists without prior qualified motion; anchor never jumps to reversal command.
sensor_quality: Invalid/stale speed displays INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT, retains anchor and causal watch age, never confirms from invalid samples; first recovered valid sample is evaluated against preserved context.
response_progress_fault_rules: Frozen R5.2.1R and R5.2 rules, using frozen R5.2.2 profile for all numeric values and response opening.
blocking_issue: Pre-registered C9 commands reach 1.0 while immutable fixture profile speed_max is 0.9. Observed semantic transitions cannot qualify C9 within the frozen fixture; do not change case post hoc.
hardware_portability: Bookkeeping is profile-driven but neither fixture validation nor hardware portability is certified while C9 violates the fixture domain. Real hardware requires separate calibration.
